title: Long exploration going vague: what must survive, and where?
head: Situation
Right mechanism
Why
rows: Session getting full, work ends today
Restarting after a break, files changed
Fresh session with a structured summary
rule: Write key findings to a scratchpad file so they survive sessions and handoffs, and push verbose searching into subagents.

title: Search output too big? Choose by whether the noise is predictable
head: Situation
Right mechanism
Why
rows: Explore subagent filters in its own context
Context already flooded, work ends soon
rule: Send noisy discovery to an Explore subagent that returns a short summary. Narrow the search instead only when the noise sits under predictable paths.

title: Picking long work back up: what carries the state?
head: What you observe
Where the fault is
Fix
rows: Crash or interruption, files changed since
Manifest or progress file, read on restart
Session long and slowing, same task
Try two approaches from one starting point
Resuming after edits you made yourself
rule: Keep progress for long jobs in a file on disk. A resumed conversation remembers what was said, not what is on disk now.

title: A long session is degrading: what keeps the specifics?
head: What you observe
Where the fault is
Fix
rows: Generic answers, contradictions; specifics needed next
Findings to a scratchpad file; fresh session reads it
Session long, only the gist needed from here
Lots of exploratory reading still to do
Crash or interruption in mechanical work
One long review thins out in the middle
rule: When a session drifts to typical patterns and contradicts itself, persist the key findings to a file and start a fresh session from it.

title: Handing over long work: what carries over, and how?
head: Situation
Right mechanism
Why
rows: Findings must survive the session or move to another person
Earlier tool results largely stale or work moves machines
New session from a structured summary
Context full but work continues now
rule: Write findings down outside the chat, and start fresh from a summary when much has changed.

title: Session degrading: what is flooding the context?
head: What you observe
Where the fault is
Fix
rows: Repeated verbose output (logs, test runs) floods the context
Verbose work done in the main session
Delegate to a subagent that returns a summary
Progress must persist across a session boundary
New session from a structured summary
rule: Send noisy, repeated work to a subagent and keep only its summary in the main session.

title: Context trouble? Ask whether the session is still healthy
head: What you observe
Diagnosis
Fix
rule: Healthy but full → /compact. Degraded or crossing sessions → notes file and a fresh session.
